reviews.text: We have been going here with my dog ​​for years and we are very satisfied with Dr. Éva Gunde, the veterinarian. She is kind and attentive, always gives good advice and answers questions willingly. The receptionists are also helpful and kind.

The doctors and nurses are kind and helpful, I had a completely positive experience with them, they treated my partner's dog kindly and competently
However, the style of one of the older receptionists is decidedly impolite and rude. It would be worth taking a little back from the pretentiousness and communicating with the visitors in a more human-centered and respectful way, as befits a professional veterinary clinic!
Best regards, V. Zalán
I took my chameleon for an eye exam because of inflammation. They treated him professionally, explained everything, and spent a lot of time with us. Great place!

We had a very positive experience at the clinic. We came with our French bulldog, and although we have not yet been able to fully identify the full cause of the problem with complete certainty, we are very grateful for the attitude and care. ❤️
The entire staff was extremely kind, empathetic and helpful, and the doctor treated us very thoroughly and reassuringly.
I wholeheartedly recommend the clinic.

my dog is seriously ill with congestive heart failure and urgently needed his prescribed diuretic. i came here because i needed a prescription to buy a medication that costs around 700 HUF. they wanted to charge me 4.000 HUF just to issue the prescription. i refused, traveled across the city to my dog’s actual vet, and they gave me the prescription for free. by the time this entire ordeal was over, my sick dog had gone hours without an important medication.

when an animal urgently needs medicine, this is exactly the kind of situation where i’d hope an animal clinic would prioritize the animal’s welfare rather than finding another opportunity to charge money. this experience left me with the impression that making 4,000 forints mattered more than helping a sick animal get the medication he needed.

UPDATE: the vets response blatantly misrepresents what happened. they did not refuse to prescribe the medication out of concern for my dog’s safety. they had already made the prescription. only after already making the recipe did they tell me it would cost 4.000 HUF and i declined to pay

i gave them my dog’s veterinary paperwork showing the medication and dosage, with his treating vet’s contact information. if verification was genuinely the concern, they could have called his vet. they didn’t.

don’t make this about my dog’s welfare. its sunday, my seriously ill dog unexpectedly runs out of an important medication and his regular vet is across the city. i needed a quick solituon. charging 4,000 HUF to prescribe a medication that costs around 700 HUF under those circumstances is what i found ridiculous.

The online appointment booking was quick and easy, the clinic itself is sophisticated, clean and modern. The staff was extremely knowledgeable and kind, we received professional care and detailed information, I can only recommend it to everyone!
We go here with both of our "children" (dog and cat). We are extremely satisfied. Expertise, attention, clean and modern environment
We have been coming here from the other side of town since we found Dr. Éva Gunde. She is kind, attentive, I feel like Prézli is in the best hands with her!

They took very kindly, patiently, and professionally care of my sick cat... special thanks to Dr. Ákos Gyuricza, an empathetic, true gentleman. : ) I can only praise the entire team, five stars to everyone! :)

I do not recommend the exotic vet to anyone. Two weeks ago we took my Dwarf Bearded Dragon there because of a molting complaint, he would not open his right eye so I took him to be examined. The “very kind doctor” checked if there was any other problem, inflammation in his mouth or abdomen and said that everything was fine with him. He looked at his eyes and concluded that there was an injury in his right eye caused by molting. The extensive medical examination started with tweezers, where he started removing pieces of skin from his eye, supposedly stuck there from molting. He prescribed eye drops for humans and an eye cream because the cornea was damaged. They didn’t even want to give him an age chart at first and when you gave him one, it was written with Chat GPT (you can tell from the fact that he talked about how the chat gpt can’t describe the mass and the age chart said it was irritation caused by chemicals, which was not mentioned). We should have taken him back a week later but the female doctor was not very nice and his condition worsened and he did not eat after the treatment. Instead we took him to the Veterinary University and they were much kinder and more thorough and they established that he did not open his eyes due to eye irritation but due to kidney inflammation. (They said here that everything was fine in his stomach, so no) they cleaned his eyes thoroughly and gave him an infusion and prescribed antibiotics, disinfectant and eye disinfectant medicine which is for animals and not humans. We took him back today and they said that unfortunately the infection had eaten his eye and spread to the other eye despite the medicines and there was no other choice but to put him to sleep. If we had taken him there earlier they would have been able to cure him. They charged double the price for nothing they did here and I think this is not the first time an animal has died after the "Big Treatment". I do not recommend this place to anyone (certainly not the exotic animal "doctor") (do not bring agama snakes here)

They were very polite and helpful, they accepted us without an appointment and helped us as soon as they could in an emergency, making sure not to cause too much delay for others. I recommend them to everyone :)

I brought our budgie in with a nervous system problem. He wasn't feeling well. The doctor explained in detail the possible causes and options. The prescribed treatment was effective, the parrot recovered in about 20 days. I recommend it to everyone.

We called the clinic on a Saturday for surgery: our hyperactive dog had cut his tongue off with a piece of wood. We immediately got an appointment with Dr. Éva Gunde. Our dog was taken to the operating room with zero waiting time, and after the 1.5-hour, successful surgery, he was already eating that day. The clinic operates at an incredibly high standard, we have never met a more professionally prepared veterinarian than the Doctor, even though our dogs have provided work for various clinics... Client-centricity and maximum attention here are not luxuries, but the most basic characteristics. The assistance is also fantastic, our dog loves them, everyone was incredibly kind. Thank you!!
The receptionist's style is phlegmatic, no one informed me that there was more than an hour delay, which I think would be the minimum. Plus, it's annoying that the same music is playing all day.

On August 27th (Thursday) at 8:00 PM, we made an appointment for an abdominal ultrasound for Saturday at 10:40 AM. They confirmed the appointment by email, and we were really looking forward to it because we wanted to know what was causing our dog's lethargy. On Saturday, of course, when we were on our way to the examination, we received a phone call 40 minutes before the appointment that they couldn't do the full abdominal ultrasound because there was no specialist available, only a general veterinarian, and they could make an appointment for Thursday next week because there was a specialist in the office then. This wasn't listed anywhere on their website. We already have the results from the general veterinarian, but we made an appointment with them precisely because a specialist performs the examination, and we could (should) go on the weekend. Perhaps this phone call could have been made on Friday as well, it would have been appropriate to have notified us in time so that we could look for another clinic, because people don't take their pets to the doctor out of boredom, but because there is probably a problem, possibly pain. So we have to spend the entire weekend at home knowing what could be wrong with the dog, what could be causing it pain. Thank you for the correct administration!

They are very kind, thorough, patient! We went on Saturday with a dachshund with back pain. They spoke so kindly to every animal, I think that says a lot about a place. They always had a smile on their face. They examined the dog thoroughly, they didn't ask for unnecessary treatment or diagnostics. Completely normal prices, especially compared to the standard. We wholeheartedly recommend the place!!!
Kind and attentive treatment, they also provide patient and comprehensive explanations to the owner's questions.

We received excellent care during the long weekend, as always.
Thank you!

A few weeks ago we went to the clinic for a pre-neuter examination of a guinea pig.
The doctor was very kind and gentle with the piglet.
We discussed everything and he examined the piglet thoroughly. (The surgery took place in 2 weeks)

On the day of the surgery, I was greeted by a very kind doctor. She also explained everything and I felt that our beloved piglet would be in good hands. A few hours later, they sent the medical record by email, saying that the surgery was successful and that the piglet was doing well. A little later, they called me on the phone to say that she was doing well, eating and that we could go pick her up. There, the assistant ladies very kindly explained everything about what to do at home, medication dosage, etc.
What was very nice was that the price of the examination (18,990 HUF) was deducted from the price of the surgery. In short, I recommend the clinic to everyone because they are very fair and good professionals. What is important is that there is a doctor every day.

They ask you to arrive at least 10 minutes early in the email, but in the end we were called in almost 30 minutes late.
When I asked the receptionist how long it would take, because my cat was already shaking with fear, the answer I got was “I don’t know either.” Unfortunately, that wasn’t very helpful or empathetic.

However, the doctor was fantastic. We had been to several vets, but she was the first one who could really help us with our problem. She was very thorough, kind and knowledgeable, so I recommend the doctors wholeheartedly.

What I am deducting a little from my rating is the organization and the attitude I experienced at the reception. For this reason, I don’t necessarily recommend that you arrive much earlier, or that you don’t expect a particularly kind welcome at the reception. However, the medical care was excellent!

Saci is the best! Fedor, our giant schnauzer, doesn't go to a dog grooming salon, but to a five-star wellness center. 😄🐶✂️ He always comes home beautiful and smelling good - although his personality remains the same. 😂 We recommend Saci wholeheartedly! 🐾

Both of my little shelties were entrusted to the hands of Dr. Ákos Gyuricza.
I am super satisfied with the care, the doctor and the team were very kind, patient and thorough, they treated the puppies with great attention every time. Thank you for making me feel safe during the procedures, as they are very sensitive puppies, so I am truly grateful for everything!
The team was super kind and empathetic with my dog🥹❤️
We were very satisfied with the care

We asked the doctor in advance how much we would pay so that we wouldn't be surprised by the total amount.
There were no other medical interventions that came up, max. about 4 force-feedings. They even asked the reception to print out the statement, but there was a technical error, so we didn't do that. We paid 70-80 thousand more than the amount stated. Even after deducting the fee, it was much more than what was agreed upon.
First class care, highly professional treatment for your pet. Very friendly veterinary institution! Thank you!

We chose the clinic based on the reviews, I wish I hadn't.
We brought my 2-year-old guinea pig to the clinic with the symptom of red urine, which we noticed in the evening, and we made an appointment for the next morning.
The doctor determined that he needed urgent surgery due to urinary stones, and he didn't recommend any other solution/alternative.
Of course, since our goal was for him to get well as soon as possible and not be in pain, we decided on emergency surgery.
We were informed that we could pick him up the same day after the surgery, but they would call us first.
They didn't do this when I called them, they didn't answer the phone, so I went to the clinic in person because I was worried why they weren't calling me by the promised time. (I didn't get an explanation for this).
The assistant asked me to wait a bit because the pet wasn't awake enough yet. (of course, I didn't want to bring it either)
When they told me I could go in, they lifted my piglet to show me the location of the surgery, and the pet completely flinched.
After that, I only received a few short sentences of information about the medication dosage and the check-up time, no help with what and how I should feed it after the surgery, what I should do if it doesn't eat on its own, at what intervals I should feed it, etc.
I had to read it online and ask other owners for advice, because I didn't get any information about this at the clinic.
When I asked, the answer was that it was on the medical record (there was 1 sentence on the medical record, regarding the medication dosage)

The total cost was 200 thousand forints, which you would think would mean that your pet would be treated kindly, but that's not what happened here.
I haven't received a bill to this day.

Unfortunately, my piglet did not get better, so I called them the next day, I did not receive any meaningful help, but they informed me about the cost of the emergency.
We went to the clinic again in person, where a new, kind doctor and his assistant helped me willingly, patiently and professionally - just as the other doctor should have done the first time - but unfortunately it was too late, my piglet passed away in the evening.
I am terribly saddened and outraged by what happened, because if they had looked at my piglet's condition with due attention (as the second doctor did), that he had lost a lot of blood before the surgery and had drunk little fluid - which I told you - they would have seen that he was not in a condition to be operated on and we could have chosen a different method and he could have been saved.
The only positive thing is how he was treated the second time, the assistant and the doctor took care of him as I would have done.

This will not bring my guinea pig back, I am only writing this so that others can learn from my story.

In short: I don't recommend it.

During the Pentecost long weekend, we had a hard time finding an emergency vet that would take care of a bunny. DogmoVet welcomed us right away, with a completely realistic emergency fee. The doctor examined our bunny thoroughly in very civilized conditions, immediately took an X-ray, explained everything in detail, and repeatedly indicated that we should feel free to ask questions. He provided our bunny, who was in critical condition, with appropriate medications, and we also received medications and therapeutic guidance for home delivery. At today's check-up, we also received high-level care, and our bunny Saci is much better!

Super nice receptionist and doctors, my dog ​​with extreme PTSD was examined with the right attention and kindness to make the examination panic-free. Great prices, even better staff. From now on, I will take both of my dogs here! Thank you for the good experience.
They are kind, helpful, open on Sundays and have friendly prices.

I was there with my chameleon yesterday because his eyes wouldn't open. I called them the day before yesterday to ask what to do. They were able to help me over the phone but I realized that I would need medical expertise here. We went in, they examined him, cleaned his eyes and gave me eye drops to treat him at home for 10 days. The doctor was very kind, I could see that she was good at her job and it was even cheaper than many places that wouldn't be so helpful. If something happens to my other animals in the future, I will 1000% bring them here too.
My cat was in the best hands!✨ Thank you again for everything! 🙏🏻 …
We went to see Dr. Éva Gunde for a wasp sting. She examined my dog ​​thoroughly and gave him the appropriate treatment. They were very kind and patient.

On Good Friday before Easter, I was looking for a Veterinary Clinic for our dog. I received appropriate information on the phone about the on-call fee, which was a realistic amount in such a case. In addition, the Receptionist was extremely kind, and we got an appointment for the afternoon, which they also sent us a confirmation by email. By the way, you can also register on their website. In addition, the current and detailed price list is also up there. I can only recommend this truly well-equipped and pharmacy-clean Clinic to everyone. Dr. Éva Gunde has a high degree of empathy and great expertise. The assistant lady was also very attentive. The doctor gave me really detailed information about what to do at home. Since they also have a wide range of animal medicines, I didn't have to "run" to the veterinary pharmacy separately during the holidays.
Overall, I would give it 10 ☆ !!!

I can only recommend the place to everyone, I was there for the second time with my other dog and it is incredible how professional they work there and how fair they are with the pricing for such a high quality place.
Everyone is very nice and they treat the animals very well.
I will definitely always take my dogs here :)

Very well-equipped, modern clinic, equipment, we received answers to all our questions, consultations were held with Dr. Ákos Gyuricza, he examined our dog, professional attitude, I can only recommend him!
I am satisfied with everything, the place is characterized by very kind nurses and preparedness

I can only recommend it to everyone, even with the unfortunate outcome. We have had a long journey in the past 1 month. Unfortunately, we were unable to save Puszedli the bunny🥺, but the conscientious care and long-term help made his last month as happy as possible. The team was always humane to us, even when we urgently needed to bring our bunny in. They were always kind enough to provide us with all the information we needed over the phone. They work at very fair prices, and there are always suggestions on what can be done for the comfort of the little animal.

I am very grateful to the clinic and Dr. Dániel Zibilianu, who cured my rabbit. He did an extremely thorough and conscientious job. I was very correctly informed about every detail of the treatment.
We will be returning patients. :)
I can only recommend DogmoVet, after we turned to them for help in the last weeks of our two pet rats. Expertise, humanity, fair prices.

The attitude of the workers towards the animals is fantastic. Nice, clean, cultured place. Doctors with immense knowledge. Even though we have an exotic bird, our hats are off to the knowledge and helpfulness of the doctor (Dr. Balázs Bence).
We would like to thank all the kind workers for their work ❤️
I can only recommend them to everyone.❤️

Friendly and competent staff. Short waiting time, good english skills and instructions are given in detail verbally and printed. My dogs wound healed quite well with medication and instructions given by the vet.

Everyone in the clinic is very kind and helpful. They performed thorough examinations on our guinea pig, explaining everything patiently. It is easy to book an appointment, and the confirmation comes quickly. They send the detailed medical record, including X-rays and ultrasounds, by email so that we have them too. A professional team, I recommend them to everyone if they need to see a doctor with their little pet! Thank you! ❤️🐾
We are grateful for the quick help!!🙂 …
We received great care!!😊 I recommend it!!😉 …

Luckily we only went for vaccinations, but we were still very satisfied. The entire team was kind and helpful, and all our questions were answered. The office is clean, friendly, and has a relaxed atmosphere. We have been to many veterinary offices, but this was by far our best experience. We will definitely be back – hopefully for vaccinations next time. 😊
Thank you!

Everyone is very professional and kind, we arrived with a Bengal kitten and were amazed at how professionally they handled the little one, despite his difficult nature! We are grateful for their help and dedicated work.
They were very kind and helpful!
They were kind, understanding and helpful.
They were very kind and helpful! I can only recommend them! A big hug for helping my cat! ❤️

We asked for help with the care of our dwarf rabbit one Sunday afternoon. They explained everything very kindly over the phone, we were there within half an hour and our rabbit received the care a few minutes later. Professional and very kind team!

They are very kind, they treat the animals with love and care. Their expertise and equipment are exemplary. I am grateful that they did everything they could to save my little dog /Bernese Mountain Dog, 8 months old/. Thank you very much.

I have only positive experiences with the veterinary clinic. The people working there are very kind, attentive and always helpful. You can feel that they really care about the animals and the owners. Thank you for your conscientious work!
My budgie received extremely high-quality care, for which I would like to thank you very much. Empathetic, knowledgeable doctor, helpful assistant, thorough examination 🙂 …

I found the clinic on Google Maps on Sunday morning when we were looking for an open veterinarian in the 13th district. I immediately received helpful advice on the phone regarding our cat’s problem. About 20 minutes later, the situation became more urgent, I called them back, and I received a reassuring answer that we should go ahead and examine Maxi between two appointments.

Dr. Éva Gunde and Nikoletta Kristóf performed the examination; they were extremely kind and patient with our cat throughout – and with us, the worried owners. It was clear from every word they said that they love animals, and for them it is a real profession, not just a job.

In addition to the extremely correct, humane attitude of the clinic, I would also like to write an opinion about the environment: a clean, cultured space, with enough seating and a bathroom for those waiting. Upon entering the examination room, even a layman noticed the neat, modern equipment; They were able to do an ultrasound right away - and we were able to be with our cat in the meantime.

Considering the quality of the care and the location, the examination fee was extremely fair.

I sincerely recommend it to anyone looking for a reliable, kind and truly dedicated veterinary team.
He was a very nice exotic doctor. He examined him thoroughly. He even cut his claws, my guinea pig even bit the doctor because he left him alone🥰I recommend him to everyone. …
Dr. Éva Gunde is extremely helpful, empathetic and very precise! I recommend it!❤️

Dr. Éva Gunde examined the cat, she is thorough, patient, and answers all questions. Thank you for your patience here too. The waiting room and surgery are friendly and well-equipped. It is reassuring that on weekends there are appointments between 10 am and 5 pm, it is possible to book an appointment for the given day, and when booking an appointment, if necessary, the pet can be transported. There is a phone number on the website that can be called after business hours.

Thank you for everything to Dr. Éva Gunde and her staff! I am grateful to have met such honest and compassionate people.
Unfortunately, we didn't have a chance with my cat!🖤😢
Regardless, I wholeheartedly recommend her to all owners. …
The doctor there is a huge zero.
Dr. Éva Gunde explained everything very kindly, patiently and reassuringly. Her holistic approach helped me a lot in understanding my dog's condition and symptoms. I am grateful to her!

We first chose this clinic because of its geographical proximity, where our kitten was cared for in a very pleasant environment by an extremely kind, patient, helpful and prepared team. This applies to both the doctors and the assistants. Thank you very much for the continuous high-quality professional care. 😊 …

Good afternoon,

I would just like to say thank you for the amazing quick care, our dog Max received, after he eat nuts and raisins. Superb, highly professional service, great English and super clean.

Kind regards,

David

My sister's dog was treated at the clinic. They suspected several diseases, but they couldn't tell what was wrong with the dog. My sister brought the poor animal to them for infusions for days. After it didn't improve at all, and in fact, its condition only got much worse, we took it to another clinic today, where after various examinations they were able to almost immediately determine that the dog was unfortunately beyond saving because it had cancerous tumors all over its body and was in terrible pain. Unfortunately, the dog had to be put to sleep in the end. In my opinion, with sufficient expertise and attention, the dog could have been spared 3-4 days of unbearable suffering, and my sister could have been spared the terrible mental burden she had to endure in those few days. But instead, they told her to take it to an infusion every day for 40-50 thousand forints. It is incomprehensible to me (especially after reading all the positive reviews here) that something like this can happen these days, and what people are willing to do for money. I am prepared for an “explanation” in a reply comment, and yes, paper can hold a lot of weight, but unfortunately it doesn’t change the facts. I am terribly outraged by what happened and I find it extremely disgusting. I do not recommend this clinic to anyone.
Fantastic doctors and extremely kind receptionists greeted me during my visit yesterday. Highly recommended!
Thank you very much for the quick help with our dog on Sunday, a true animal-friendly professional team 🐶 …

I am incredibly grateful to everyone from the doctor to the assistant, because they provided high-quality care for my cat. Everyone was very kind and I received all the necessary information for the recovery of our little family member.
Thank you for your help! :)
Dr. Balazs Bence is the best, I can only recommend him. Professional

We came here from a popular clinic on Jász Street, where they conscientiously examined my dog, considering all possibilities. At the previous place, they said that the dog was old and it was over. They didn't even try to find an alternative, so we switched. Dogmovet is the best veterinary clinic in town. I'm willing to come from 63km because it's worth it! I can only recommend it to everyone who is looking for a professional, skilled, humane, conscientious doctor!

The best veterinary clinic in Budapest! We have experienced “conveyor belt” care everywhere so far, not even minimally here. I hope everyone thinks like me and is willing to wait a long time in the waiting room to be called in, even if they arrived for an appointment. This should be the normal attitude everywhere from both doctors and owners. Here, a thorough, professional, all-contingencies examination takes place, no one is bothered in 10 minutes, half-examined, for a lot of money. The doctor, the assistant girl and the receptionists are also very, very nice, it seems that they are not acting like they love the animals out of a work obligation, but they really care about the health of every little creature. The waiting room, pharmacy, examination room are ultra-modern, calm, no oppressive atmosphere, or sour and phlegmatic receptionists and doctors like elsewhere. So, everyone should be willing to wait their turn, it is worth it! :) I recommend Feliway spray for cats in their carrier, and there's definitely something available for dogs that will make them calmer and less stressed at the vet/in the waiting room. :)
My dog ​​received exemplary care, he recovered in a short time, thank you!

Dear Veronika!

Thank you very much for taking the time to review, however, we did not find a treatment or service with such a customer or contact name in our system. If you are our customer, please indicate this in your comment so that we can investigate your complaint.

Thank you:

Péter Gárdos
DogmoVet-DogmoPharm

Yesterday was incredibly hurtful and humiliating for me. My cat has renal lymphoma, she has been receiving chemo for a year and a half, and when her kidney values ​​spike, we usually go for an infusion for 7-8 days. The place where she is being treated for her cancer couldn't treat her yesterday because they are open for limited hours, and my cat receives a long infusion at that time. I called the Dogmovet clinic this morning to see if they could accept her so that she could receive a 100-120 ml infusion at 25 ml/h with an infusion pump, while I was there with her, because she is very stressed anyway. The receptionist on the phone said of course, let's go calmly. When they called me in, I told the doctor in detail that I only wanted an infusion, nothing else, I showed her medical record, how and what she received from her doctor yesterday, as well as her most recent lab results. I indicated that it was difficult to cannulate due to the chemo treatments and that he was nervous, and that he tolerated it best when he was wrapped in a blanket (as is customary in oncology) and not at the neck where the skin and fur were torn. This was refused, saying that the assistant wanted to hold him by the neck (I didn't say anything about it), and that the cat's neck was bruised, which I can prove with a photo. Of course, the cannulation was unsuccessful, as is usually the case, and the cat was very nervous. When I wanted to go over to pet him to calm him down, the doctor sent me in a raised tone to not touch the cat and to sit on the chair. I also indicated that his doctor requested that he only receive freshly opened infusions and equipment (he had already had several infections), and I asked that he only be injected with one cannula once, and that I would gladly pay for another one, but his doctor also requested this because of the infections, since he has no immune system. The doctor didn't like this, and he was injected with one cannula several times, even though I directly asked him not to do it. His medical record stated what kind of infusion he could receive, but they wanted to give him another one. Then we went into another room where they asked how he usually receives his infusions, I told him this again, and then they told him that they wouldn't connect him to a pump because they didn't like it. The cat was so nervous here that he vomited, peed in it, and his stomach also went (this had never happened before). After I asked for the pump several times, they very kindly put the cat on it, then the doctor came in and said that she would not give a 100 ml infusion because she could not see the cat's vein, her leg must be edematous. I kindly told her that she had never had edema before, she had always received the infusion this way for almost a year, there had never been a problem, and her veins were not visible at other times because of the many punctures. She sarcastically said that I had an answer for everything, then added that this was a different practice, completely ignoring the cat's doctor's medical record from the previous day. At the end, she responded in a similar tone, and then at the reception they charged 56 thousand forints for the 4-hour infusion, without any examination. I hope this will never happen to anyone again, it is extremely outrageous that a sick animal is treated this way, just because I asked for it to receive the infusion as it received from its doctor yesterday. I was never disrespectful to them and raised my voice or spoke back in a similar style. Only the receptionist was kind to me. The doctor did not send me either the medical record or the invoice, I went in the next day and asked for it. The invoice includes three intravenous cannulations, while she put one cannula in the cat, the rest she failed to do. I would be happy to pay the price of the cannulas as I said, but I don't think it's 7000 HUF each. The item on the invoice is not justified at all and is just a rip-off because I didn't like her. I don't recommend the clinic to anyone.

Nice, clean, modernly equipped clinic. After making an appointment by phone on Sunday, they saw our sick dog within a few hours, which meant a lot to us in the given situation. It's great that they are open on weekends! Blood tests and their evaluation were performed on site, while the infusion was dripping. The examination was performed by Dr. Bence Balázs; both he and his colleagues were very kind, attentive, empathetic, and professional. Thank you! I recommend the clinic to others.

I took a newly adopted kitten for a check-up, so I made an appointment for the same day at dawn. It's great that there is an online booking option. The clinic is modern and has a pet pharmacy in the same place. Everyone was very nice, Morfeusz got a little snack while we waited, because we arrived first. :D

I left with very good experiences and we will go again :)

Great service! Very kind doctors, nurses and receptionists. They speak English, so we didn’t have a problem.

Our dog had to have an urgent surgery, but now she feels fine, absolutely healthy, and I don’t even see the scar on her abdomen 😱

Would definitely recommend it.
The doctor, his assistant, and the receptionists were all extremely helpful and kind. The diagnosis was accurate because our dog has since recovered.

In my 71 years, I have never met such a kind, helpful medical team. I would like to highlight the devoted, kind, expert attitude of Dr. Éva Gunde and Nikolett Grànicz, their heartfelt attitude to my dog ​​Mollik. They did everything❣️unfortunately their resuscitation was unsuccessful, unfortunately they could not perform a miracle, but they would have done it according to their hearts❣️❤️I will think of them with a grateful heart until I die.❣️❤️🥰
It is demanding, and the colleagues were extremely kind and knowledgeable with us.

Both of our dogs received excellent care every time. Helpful doctors, assistants and a friendly environment. Each pet gets a treat if you allow it. I was also surprised (positively) by the price every time. A knowledgeable, kind and friendly team, each doctor does a great job and provides everyone with understandable advice.

Aresz's owner
